name: Hardcore Worlds 1: Lumbridge to Waterfall Quest

steps.name: How this route works
steps.noteText: Based on B0aty's HCIM Guide V3 (OSRS Wiki), changed for a main account on Hardcore Worlds. Section names keep B0aty's bank numbers. The aim of Parts 1-3 is 43 Prayer (Protect from Melee/Missiles/Magic) before any real risk. Part 1 ends at Waterfall Quest.

steps.name: One life: the rules
steps.noteText: Eat at half health, not later. Never fight anything new without reading its max hit in the step note. If a step says 'drink on any damage', do it. Teleport out the moment something goes wrong: a death here sends the character to the main game.

steps.name: Launch week crowds
steps.noteText: Everyone starts in the same places. Shop empty? Hop worlds; if it stays empty, the step note says what to do instead. Quests are never contested, so the route leans on them. The Grand Exchange is nearly empty the first days: don't count on it early.

steps.name: Found a bug?
steps.noteText: This route was built on an account that had already done most of it, so a few steps may be off: a wrong tile, or a step that won't tick itself off. Tick it by hand and report it on GitHub (BlackDeath-Osrs/route-planner).

steps.name: Talk to Father Aereck
steps.noteText: Starts The Restless Ghost.

steps.name: Pickpocket a man or woman
steps.noteText: Lumbridge Easy Diary. Once is enough.

steps.name: Drop your air and mind runes
steps.noteText: Drop them next to the tutor so they're easy to pick back up.

steps.name: Claim runes from the Magic tutor
steps.noteText: Mikasi gives 30 of each.

steps.name: Pick your runes back up
steps.noteText: Your dropped runes are still on the ground: you keep both lots.

steps.name: Sell the starter gear
steps.itemList: Bronze dagger, Bronze sword, Wooden shield, Shortbow
steps.noteText: Lumbridge general store.

steps.name: Buy a spade, chisel and hammer
steps.noteText: Out of spades? Hop worlds.

steps.name: Start X Marks the Spot
steps.noteText: Then dig for the first clue (Quest Helper shows the spot).

steps.name: X Marks the Spot: first dig
steps.noteText: Dig outside Bob's Brilliant Axes.

steps.name: Check your play time with Hans
steps.noteText: Lumbridge Easy Diary.

steps.name: Take 4 logs on the top floor
steps.noteText: For Tree Gnome Village. They respawn: wait if someone beats you to them.

steps.name: Bank: deposit everything
steps.noteText: Keep the shrimps in the bank (Family Crest). Coins in slot 1, runes at the top, placeholders on. Set a bank PIN.

steps.name: Withdraw supplies
steps.itemList: Coins, Air rune, Mind rune, Bread, Spade, Tinderbox, Air talisman, Treasure scroll

steps.name: Fill the jug and bowl
steps.itemList: Jug of water, Bowl of water
steps.noteText: Use them on the sink (Monk's Friend).

steps.name: X Marks the Spot: second dig
Kill a giant rat
steps.noteText: Wind Strike it.

steps.name: Take the bones and raw rat meat
steps.noteText: Raw rat meat is for Druidic Ritual.

steps.name: Get the Ghostspeak amulet
steps.noteText: Go west hugging the fence. Wear the amulet.

steps.name: Take the leather gloves
steps.noteText: On the table in his house. Wear them.

steps.name: Wizards' Tower: leather boots and logs
steps.noteText: Boots off the table (wear them), logs by the stairs.

steps.name: Kill a chicken
steps.noteText: On the way north to Draynor. You need its feather: no feather, kill another (Client of Kourend, Druidic Ritual).

steps.name: Take the feather and raw chicken
Get cheese from Aggie
steps.noteText: Witch's House.

steps.name: X Marks the Spot: third dig
Take 4 garlic upstairs
steps.noteText: Spam-click the cupboard for several (Fishing Contest).

steps.name: Draynor rooftops to 5 Agility
steps.noteText: Lumbridge Easy Diary.

steps.name: Buy wine from Fortunato
steps.noteText: 5 per world: hop once. Read the notice board next to him to start A Porcine of Interest.

steps.name: X Marks the Spot: last dig
Finish X Marks the Spot
steps.noteText: Keep the lamp for later (it can't be banked: destroy it and reclaim it from Veos).

steps.name: Sail to Port Piscarilius
steps.noteText: Talk to Veos at Port Sarim and travel to Port Piscarilius.

steps.name: Shayzien: take the beer
steps.noteText: Then use the feather on the enchanted scroll.

steps.name: Talk to Jennifer
steps.noteText: In the general store.

steps.name: Tinderbox, wizard hat and orange dye
steps.noteText: The hat and dye are in Shayzien Styles, west of the store.

steps.name: Stronghold floor 1: Gift of Peace
steps.noteText: Answer the door questions (never give out your password: 'No' or 'Report it' answers). Floor 1 monsters hit low, but eat early. The chest gives 2,000 coins and the Flap emote.

steps.name: Stronghold floor 2: Grain of Plenty
steps.noteText: Down the ladder next to the Gift of Peace. 3,000 coins and the Slap Head emote.

steps.name: Stronghold floor 3: Box of Health
steps.noteText: DANGER: spiders hit up to 7, so drink a wine at 3+ damage before each door. Catablepons hit up to 9: drink on any damage. Take the east doors. 5,000 coins and the Idea emote.

steps.name: Leave the Stronghold the safe way
steps.noteText: Up the goo-covered vine next to the Box of Health, then up and out the way you came. NEVER take the dripping vine down: floor 4 can kill a new account.

steps.name: Barbarian Village: beer and meat
steps.noteText: Beers in the Longhall. The meat is for Mourning's End Part II.

steps.name: Pick doogle leaves
steps.noteText: Just south of Gertrude's house.

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.noteText: Main account: you can sell or buy here at the Grand Exchange later, but early prices are wild.

steps.name: Buy an air staff
steps.noteText: Wear it. Use the bones on the stray dog whenever you see it.

steps.name: Thessalia's shop
steps.noteText: Varrock Easy Diary.

steps.name: Take the lit candle
steps.noteText: Up the ladder in the sword shop.

steps.name: Dr Harlow
steps.noteText: Talk to him twice; give him the beer.

steps.name: Children of the Sun
steps.noteText: Follow Quest Helper to the end.

steps.name: Reldo: start Shield of Arrav
steps.noteText: Search for the book, then talk to him again (1).

steps.name: Palace kitchen: buckets and pie dish
steps.noteText: Upstairs in the palace kitchen. The pie dish is for The Knight's Sword.

steps.name: Pour it down the drain
steps.noteText: The drain is just outside the kitchen. Demon Slayer: this washes the key into the sewer.

steps.name: Demon Slayer key in the sewer
steps.noteText: North-west path. The giant rats are aggressive but hit 1.

steps.name: Natural history quiz
steps.noteText: Downstairs in the museum: 9 Slayer, 9 Hunter and 28 kudos.

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Coins, Saw, Hammer, Knife, Bronze axe, Research package, Tinderbox

steps.name: Old Man Yarlo
steps.noteText: Light both logs, talk to him, break all the furniture, talk again (2).

steps.name: Logs and ashes after the cutscene
Lumberyard
steps.noteText: Make 10 planks and the 3 waxwood planks. Main account: skip B0aty's 2,100 arrowshafts.
steps.itemList: 10 plank,3 waxwood plank,5 Bolt of cloth,100 Steel nails

steps.name: Cut the dying tree
steps.noteText: Varrock Easy Diary.

steps.name: Fix Old Man Yarlo's house
steps.itemList: Saw, Hammer, Plank, Waxwood plank, Bolt of cloth, Steel nails
steps.noteText: Talk to Yarlo, then build every repair spot in the house (the hotspots light up when you use the build option). Afterwards light 1 log, take 1 log and pick up the ashes.

steps.name: Finish Daddy's Home
steps.noteText: Then open the crate for the reward.

steps.name: Buy rune packs
steps.itemList: Fire rune pack, Air rune pack, Earth rune pack, 2 Water rune pack, 3 Mind rune pack
steps.noteText: Launch week: likely empty. Take what you can and hop once; don't wait.

steps.name: Wear leather gloves
steps.noteText: For picking nettles.

steps.name: South of the city
steps.itemList: 3 Logs, Rope, Pestle and mortar, Vial of water

steps.name: Nettles and sweetcorn
steps.noteText: Wear the leather gloves for the nettles (Ghosts Ahoy, Skippy). Sweetcorn: Recipe for Disaster.

steps.name: Hunter Guild
steps.noteText: The bucket of water is by the bank chest.

steps.name: Take 28 Eclipse red
steps.noteText: Up both ladders in Apatura's building. Hop worlds as you go. These are your first money. This might be difficult on hardcore main. Could be camped or not enough worlds to hop. consider skipping if needed

steps.name: Sunset Coast loot
steps.itemList: Fly fishing rod,Lobster pot,3 Iron bar,Big fishing net,Feather
steps.noteText: DANGER on the way: aggressive monsters along the path. Hop worlds for the iron bars.

steps.name: Buy 6 onions
steps.noteText: Food store (Yellow dye later).

steps.name: Sell all 28 to Antonius
steps.noteText: Sell them in one go. This pays for the next part of the route.

steps.name: Buy 3 Sunbeam ales
steps.noteText: +1 Agility boost for the Taverley Dungeon shortcut later.

steps.name: Gem store (optional)
steps.noteText: Uncut sapphires, emeralds, rubies for Crafting. Launch week this will be empty: skip it.

steps.name: Mistrock: food that never runs out
steps.itemList: Steel pickaxe,150 Jug of wine,20 Wizard's mind bomb,20 Stew
steps.noteText: Infinite stock, so no fighting over it. This is your food until Part 3.

steps.name: Ghost's skull
steps.noteText: Wizards' Tower basement. DANGER: a level 13 skeleton spawns. Run, don't fight.

steps.name: Finish Rune Mysteries
steps.noteText: Then teleport to the essence mine with him (Lumbridge Easy Diary).

steps.name: Bank at Draynor
steps.noteText: Finish The Restless Ghost when you pass the graveyard next (put the skull in the coffin).

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Coins, Mind rune, Small fishing net, Onion, Bronze pickaxe/Steel pickaxe, 2 Jug of wine

steps.name: Buy the Chronicle
steps.noteText: Use the pages on it and wear it. It's your emergency teleport from now on.

steps.name: Get a Slayer task
steps.noteText: Main account addition: keep a Spria task going and finish it whenever the route passes the monster. Slayer is the money plan later (Part 2: Mazchna to 37 Slayer for Killerwatts).

steps.name: Gerrant's fishing shop
steps.noteText: Take the apron off the wall and wear it.

steps.name: Fish a shrimp
steps.noteText: Small net. Karamja Easy Diary. Drop the shrimps.

steps.name: Fill the crate with bananas
steps.noteText: Use the bananas on Luthas's crate.

steps.name: Hide the rum in the crate
steps.noteText: Use the Karamjan rum on the banana crate.

steps.name: Finish the banana job
steps.noteText: Talk to Luthas to get paid. Do it before leaving Karamja.

steps.name: Wydin's food store
steps.itemList: Raw chicken, 2 Raw beef, 3 Pot of flour, 2 Redberries
steps.noteText: Buy 8 raw sardines too.

steps.name: Get a job from Wydin
steps.noteText: Wear the white apron and pick "Can I get a job here?".

steps.name: Take the rum in Wydin's back room
Deposit box
steps.noteText: Keep: mind runes, coins, 1 raw beef, Karamjan rum, onion, pickaxe, 2 wines.

steps.name: Witch's Potion
steps.noteText: Burn the beef on the range twice.

steps.name: Rommik's crafting shop
steps.itemList: Ring mould, Amulet mould, 2 Necklace mould, Bracelet mould, Sickle mould, Tiara mould, 3 Needle, 50 Thread, 3 Bucket, Shears

steps.name: Snape grass
steps.noteText: North-west of the Crafting Guild.

steps.name: Milk and kill a cow
steps.itemList: 3 Bucket of milk, Cowhide, Bones, Raw beef
steps.noteText: Milk a cow 3 times, then kill one and take the hide, bones and raw beef.

steps.name: Shear a sheep
steps.noteText: In the pen by the Makeover Mage.

steps.name: Falador crumbling wall shortcut
steps.noteText: Falador Easy Diary.

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Coins, Mind rune, Raw rat meat, Raw chicken, Raw beef, 10 Jug of wine, Bucket, Chest key, Cheese

steps.name: Haircut and pump
steps.noteText: Falador Easy Diary: get a haircut, then fill the bucket at the pump.

steps.name: Kill a duck in the park
steps.noteText: Falador Easy Diary.

steps.name: Black bear
steps.noteText: Safespot it behind the trees (it's 2x2).

steps.name: Finish Witch's House
steps.noteText: DANGER: safespot the experiment (spider form and after). Quest Helper shows the safespot. Keep the door key (Mourning's End Part II).

steps.name: Buy a vial of water pack
Dip the meats in the cauldron
steps.itemList: Enchanted beef, Enchanted rat, Enchanted bear, Enchanted chicken
steps.inventoryHighlightItems: Raw rat meat, Raw bear meat, Raw chicken, Raw beef
steps.noteText: Taverley Dungeon, past the suits of armour (they hit 2-3: run through the gate).

steps.name: Blue Moon Inn: open the chest upstairs
Withdraw
steps.itemList: Mind rune,Coins,Raw sardine,Doogle leaves,Bucket of milk,Snape grass,Rope

steps.name: Finish Gertrude's Cat
steps.noteText: Chronicle to the Champions' Guild to get there quickly. Raise the kitten if you like: a grown cat trades for death runes later.

steps.name: Bronze med helms
steps.noteText: Black Knights' Fortress, Mourning's End Part II, King's Ransom.

steps.name: Skip: Mage of Zamorak
steps.noteText: B0aty talks to the Mage of Zamorak in the Wilderness here. On Hardcore Worlds the Wilderness is going to have players hunting new accounts on release so i expect it to be more active on the first few days. Skip if you want

sections.name: Bank 12: The Knight's Sword and Prince Ali

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Coins,Pie dish,Steel pickaxe,2 Iron bar,15 Jug of wine,Bucket of water,Spade

steps.name: Redberry pie
steps.inventoryHighlightItems: Pot of flour, Bucket of water, Pastry dough, Pie dish, Pie shell, Redberries, Uncooked berry pie
steps.noteText: Make an uncooked berry pie and cook it on the range to the north. Burnt? Buy and try again.

steps.name: Thurgo
steps.noteText: Walk (keep your run energy for the dungeon).

steps.name: Blurite ore
steps.noteText: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. DANGER: safespot the ice warriors first; never mine while they're on you. Mine 2 blurite ore. The Chronicle is your way out.

steps.name: Dig in Falador Park
steps.noteText: Behind the statue's south side. Wyson the gardener attacks you: he hits 1.

steps.name: Finish The Knight's Sword
steps.noteText: Back to Thurgo for the sword, then the squire.

steps.name: Start Prince Ali Rescue
steps.noteText: Then talk to Osman.

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Coins, Mind rune, 50 Feather, Hammer, Knife, 12 Jug of wine

steps.name: Shantay's shop
steps.itemList: Desert robe, Desert shirt, 10 Bronze bar, 10 Rope, Waterskin(4), Shantay pass
steps.noteText: Wear the desert robes. Bank 7 bars and the ropes, keep 3 bars for this quest.

steps.name: The Tourist Trap
steps.noteText: DANGER: Mercenary Captain hits up to 5. Body-block him behind his soldiers and talk to the soldier to hold him in place, then safespot. Take his bones. Rewards on Agility.

steps.name: Castle Wars minigame teleport
steps.noteText: Spellbook>Minigame teleport> Castle Wars. Head to Yanille by the southern path to avoid the ogres.

steps.name: Greenman's ale
steps.noteText: Dragon Inn (Recipe for Disaster).

steps.name: Aleck's Hunter shop
steps.itemList: Butterfly net, 10 Butterfly jar, 3 Bird snare, Teasing stick, 8 Box trap
steps.noteText: Ardougne Easy Diary. Take the jug of water to the north.

steps.name: Mine 10 clay
steps.noteText: On the way to Port Khazard.

steps.name: Trader Stan's sand and glass (optional)
steps.noteText: Main account: buy what's in stock; Crafting can wait.
steps.itemList: 100 Soda ash,100 Bucket of sand,Glassblowing pipe,20 pineapple

sections.name: Bank 16: Fight Arena and Monk's Friend

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Mind rune,Coins,Logs,Jug of water,5 Jug of wine

steps.name: Fight Arena
steps.noteText: DANGER: safespot every fight over the closest corpse. Against General Khazard, escape through the door if it goes badly.

steps.name: Rat poison
steps.noteText: Under the Clock Tower (Ratcatchers).

steps.name: Start Sheep Herder
steps.noteText: Turn on Thick Skin and go north through the zoo. Pray at the altar (Ardougne Easy Diary). Buy balls of wool at the general store.

sections.name: Bank 17: Sheep Herder to Barbarian Assault

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: 4 Jug of wine, Poisoned sheep feed

steps.name: Burn all 4 sheep bones
steps.noteText: Drop the feed, plague clothes and cattleprod afterwards.

steps.name: Start Dwarf Cannon
steps.noteText: Go north hugging the Fishing Guild to avoid the moss giants. Stop where it sends you to Falador.

steps.name: Barbarian Assault
steps.noteText: Unlocks the Barbarian Assault teleport (skip the tutorial).

steps.name: Start Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
steps.noteText: The guard at the Barbarian Outpost gate gives you the Barcrawl card. Keep it: every bar stamps it.

steps.name: Bank the planks
steps.noteText: B0aty loots 139 planks here for Construction later. Optional on a main. Use barb assault bank

sections.name: Bank 18-19: Hazeel Cult and Tree Gnome Village

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Mind rune, Staff of air, Leather gloves, Leather boots, Coins, 6 Logs, Rope, Barcrawl card, 10 Jug of wine

steps.name: Start Waterfall Quest
steps.noteText: Continue until you have the Book on Baxtorian.

steps.name: Hazeel Cult
steps.noteText: Side with Hazeel.

steps.name: Tree Gnome Village
steps.noteText: DANGER: Khazard Warlord, safespot him (Quest Helper shows the spot).

steps.name: Heckel Funch's grocery
steps.itemList: 10 Pineapple,2 Orange,3 Lemon,Cocktail shaker,Cocktail glass,5 Bucket of milk,3 Vodka,Dwellberries,2 Chocolate dust

steps.name: Make a Fruit Blast
steps.inventoryHighlightItems: Cocktail shaker, Pineapple, Lemon, Orange, Knife

steps.name: Gnome Agility Course lap
steps.noteText: Western Province Easy Diary.

steps.name: Start The Grand Tree
steps.noteText: He gives you the bark sample for Hazelmere. Get the translation book in the Grand Tree too (Quest Helper shows where).

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Coins, Mind rune, Rope, Bark sample, Barcrawl card, Translation book, 10 Jug of wine

steps.name: Dragon Inn (Barcrawl)
steps.noteText: Nightmare Zone minigame teleport, then into Yanille.

steps.name: Start Tribal Totem
steps.noteText: Sail back to Ardougne and continue up to the GPDT employee.

steps.name: Sell silk
steps.noteText: 60 coins (Ardougne Easy Diary).

steps.name: Steal cakes to 6,099 Thieving XP
steps.noteText: Keep 20 bread. Crowded on launch: any Ardougne cake stall works, hop if busy.

steps.name: Wizard Cromperty
steps.noteText: Teleport to the essence mine through him first (Ardougne Easy Diary).

steps.name: Finish Tribal Totem
steps.noteText: Door code KURT. WARNING: right-click Investigate the stairs, never walk up them (trap).

steps.name: Bank at Ardougne South
steps.noteText: Keep 1 swordfish from the reward (Family Crest).

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: Dwellberries, Chocolate dust, Bucket of milk, Snape grass, Spade, Rope, 4 Bucket of water

steps.name: Plague City
steps.noteText: Quest Helper. Keep the Ardougne teleport scroll from the reward.

steps.name: Read the Ardougne teleport scroll
steps.noteText: Unlocks the Ardougne Teleport spell.

steps.name: Start Biohazard
steps.noteText: Continue until you have the plague sample. Take 1 extra rotten apple and 5 extra pigeon cages (Mourning's End Part I, One Small Favour). The chemist comes in Part 2.

steps.name: Probita's pets
steps.noteText: Ardougne Easy Diary: check her pets.

steps.name: Make 13 molten glass
steps.noteText: Observatory Quest.

steps.name: Withdraw
steps.itemList: 10 Jug of wine, Staff of air, Mind rune, 6 Air rune, 6 Earth rune, Water rune, Glarial's pebble, Rope

steps.name: Glarial's Tomb
steps.noteText: Drop runes and staff before going in (nothing worn or carried that's magic). DANGER: tank the skeleton's hit and run past the moss giants.

steps.name: Kill a fire giant
steps.noteText: Inside Baxtorian Falls. DANGER: water spells only; eat early.

steps.name: Finish Waterfall Quest
steps.inventoryHighlightItems: Glarial's amulet, Glarial's urn, Air rune, Water rune, Earth rune
steps.noteText: Free 30 Attack and Strength. End of Part 1.

steps.name: Teleport out
steps.noteText: Minigame teleport to Soul Wars, then the portal to Edgeville. Part 2 starts here.
